item.title: Discovery and Identification of Memory Corruption Vulnerabilities on Bare-metal Embedded Devices
Generative Adversarial Networks for Subdomain Enumeration
Luca Degani
item.description: Luca Degani is a PhD student in Computer Science at the University of Trento, Italy, where he is working on IoT systems security. He received his master’s degree with a thesis on evaluation metrics of bare-metal IoT firmware fuzzing. Other research interests include vulnerability detection and software testing.
